identity.original_title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown

hooks.text: 用选择重写航海史，关键角色可能提前退场
hooks.excerpt: Wonder no more: Star Trek Voyager: Across the Unknown allows players to take control and shape the journey of the U.S.S. Voyager as they want. Take a risky approach or play it safe. Be diplomatic or let phasers do the talking. Research technologies that were shunned by the crew. But: Be prepared to deal with the consequences of your actions! The game features rogue-like elements, so in each run you will encounter different situations and even iconic characters might meet an early end if you don’t react accordingly.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 重建舱室与生命支持，规划船内设施
hooks.excerpt: Restore destroyed rooms, secure life support and energy supplies, and start constructing. Ship systems, crew quarters, industrial and research facilities: You must decide what to build and when, to ensure the ship has what it needs for the perilous journey.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 按船员专长分配战位并关键时刻触发技能
hooks.excerpt: Assign battle stations to crew who bring precious skills to the table and trigger them in crucial moments to maximize your combat effectiveness.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 很好地还原了《航海家号》的视觉气质

excerpts.excerpt: The game captures a lot of the visuals, spirit, and enjoyment of Voyager.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 缺少沙盒模式限制了自由游玩

excerpts.excerpt: this game could use something like a sandbox mode
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 玩家选择对结果缺少实际影响

excerpts.excerpt: None of your decision really matter.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 重复开局内容难以快速跳过

excerpts.excerpt: I wish I could skip through up to and past the Caretaker's Array faster in subsequent playthroughs
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 坏点数可能把良好局面变成无法获胜

excerpts.excerpt: a series of bad rolls mean you have to restart an entire sector because you're in a literally unwinnable situation
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 随机性依赖过重且概率惩罚严厉

excerpts.excerpt: it's incredibly RNG dependent, and the odds are very punishing
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 主线过于线性，缺少自由探索空间

excerpts.excerpt: Its just a bit too linear, the main story constantly pushes you forward, not much room to wander off and explore really
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏具有较深的重复游玩价值

excerpts.excerpt: its deep replayability keeps the fun warping in
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 开场教程保持简单清晰

excerpts.excerpt: the tutorials in the beginning keep it nice and simple
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: The systems in the game aren't overly complicated (which I appreciate)
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
